Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

18:12304-1987 



Indian Standard 
SPECIFICATION FOR PLASTIC CERVICAL COLLAR 



( Reaffirmed 1997) 



1 . Scope — Specifies requirements for plastic cervical collar. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — The shape and dimensions of the collar shall be as per the require- 
ment. However, a typical collar is shown in Fig. 1. 



POLYETHYLENE / 





STiTCHiNO 



POLYETHYLENE 
SHEET 



SECTION XX 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 PLASTIC CERVICAL COLLAR 



3. Material 



3.1 Plastic Co//ar— ShaW be made of high density polyethylene comforming to IS : 7328-1974 
'Specification for high density polyethylene materials for moulding and extrusion'. The strip thickness 
shall be not less than 1 5 mm. 

3.2 Sewing Thread-- Cotton sewing thread of 60s/6 (100 dtex x 6) conforming to Variety 
No. 31 of IS : 1720-1978 'Specification for cotton sewing threads {second revision)'. 

4. Requirements 

4.1 The cervical collar shall be free from any manufacturing defects. 

4.2 The cervical collar shall be tailored neatly. The plastic collar shall be neatly cut to the required 
size and arranged to form a uniform thickness throughout without any wrinkles or distortions. 

4.3 The plastic collar shall be translucent. 

4.4 The plastic collar shall be pedded with foam leather to ensure maximum comfort. The foam 
leather should be non-irritant. 

4-5 The collar when worn shall not give any uncomfortable feeling. 

4.6 The collar shall be provided with small holes for ventilation. 

4.7 The length of the collar shall be adjustable to the patient's neck size by means of fastener.

4.8 The ends of the collar shall be provided with suitable fastening device like hook and loop tape 
fastener, and leather strap with buckle. The hook and loop tape fastener shall conform to IS : 8156- 
1981 'Specification for fasteners, hook and loop tape, synXheWc {first revision )' with tape having 
minimum width of 2"5 cm and overlap of 2"5 cm. The buckle shall conform to 15:4274-1981 
'Specification for buckles {first revision)', 

5. Marking 

5.1 The collar shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 
5.1,1 Standard marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards, 

6. Packaging — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This cervical collar gives very good stabilization for whiplash injuries, arthritic necks and 
wryneck. It is also used for hyperextension of cervical region.
